notes: Omen: new experience family Chassis (the cyberpunk style). Chassis in Acid, Synth and Alert: a machined frame with hatched rails and dot ladders, every part in its own tabbed module with our own line drawing and a seven-segment LCD box…

Both are laid out for every screen shape, with their own small-screen designs: Chassis shows its TIME module with CPU and GPU LCD boxes; Datasheet shows one card with the time in its header, the CPU ring and the minute graph.
